aboutPage.metaDescription: YNWA is a Doha-based business services firm handling company formation, licensing, PRO and government processes, and ongoing corporate compliance in Qatar.
aboutPage.headline: The administrative side of a company, handled.
aboutPage.lede: YNWA is a business services firm in Doha. We deal with the registrations, licences, government processes and compliance that a company in Qatar needs — so the people running it can run it.
aboutPage.thesisBody: Most firms in this market sell company formation. Formation happens once. What happens for the rest of a company's life is renewals, amendments, labour and immigration files, attestations, activity changes, partner changes — and then, when things go well, structuring and protecting what has been built.
aboutPage.thesisBody2: We are organised around that whole span rather than around the first transaction in it, which is why the services here are sorted into Start, Operate and Grow instead of into a filing cabinet. Most clients arrive needing one of the three and stay for the other two.
aboutPage.scopeTitle: What we do, and where that stops.
aboutPage.scopeBody: Our work is administrative and procedural: identifying the licensing route and the approvals that apply, preparing and submitting the paperwork, dealing with the departments, and following it through. Where a matter needs legal advice or representation, that is a lawyer's work and we will say so rather than take it on.
aboutPage.nameBody: {name} is a Doha business services firm. The initials are borrowed from a phrase about not walking alone — which, applied to paperwork, is the entire proposition.

privacyPage.metaDescription: What YNWA's website collects, why, and what it stores in your browser.
privacyPage.headline: Privacy notice
privacyPage.lede: What this website collects, why it collects it, and what it keeps in your browser. It is short because the site does very little.
privacyPage.s1body: This notice covers ynwas.com, operated by YNWA, a business services firm in Doha, Qatar. Our contact details are on the contact page and in the footer of every page.
privacyPage.s2body: Only what you type into the enquiry form: your name, your email address, your phone number if you choose to give it, which stage of a company's life your enquiry is about, and your message. Our hosting provider also keeps standard server logs, which record requests to the site and typically include an IP address.
privacyPage.s3body: To read your enquiry and answer it. That is the only purpose. We do not use it for marketing, we do not sell or share it with anyone for their own purposes, and we do not use it to build a profile of you.
privacyPage.s4body: This site carries no advertising, no advertising or social media pixels, and no third-party analytics. Nothing on it follows you to other websites.
privacyPage.s5title: What the site stores in your browser
privacyPage.s5body: Two small values, and no cookies. Your light or dark theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage so the site does not flash the wrong palette on your next visit, and a marker that you have already seen the opening animation is kept for the length of your browsing session. Both stay in your browser, are never sent to us, and clearing your site data removes them.
privacyPage.s6body: We keep an enquiry and our correspondence about it for as long as we are dealing with it and for a reasonable period afterwards, in case you come back to us about the same matter. If you would like yours deleted sooner, ask and we will delete it.
privacyPage.s7body: Write to us at the email address on the contact page to ask what we hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted. We will respond to you directly.
privacyPage.reviewNote: This notice describes how the website actually behaves, and is written to be accurate rather than to cover every eventuality. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer, and it does not attempt to state obligations under any particular data protection law. Have it reviewed before launch.

termsPage.metaDescription: Terms of use for the YNWA website.
termsPage.headline: Terms of use
termsPage.lede: The terms on which this website is offered. They cover the site itself, not any engagement between you and YNWA.
termsPage.s1body: ynwas.com is published by YNWA, a business services firm in Doha, Qatar, to describe what we do and to let people get in touch. Using the site means accepting these terms.
termsPage.s2body: What is written here describes services and processes in general terms. It is not advice on your situation, and it is not legal advice at all — our work is administrative and procedural, not legal practice. Nothing on this site should be relied on as a substitute for advice about your own case, and requirements in Qatar change.
termsPage.s3body: Where this site states a fact about Qatar it cites a primary source and the date it was last checked against it. Those sources are published by other organisations, and neither their content nor their continued accuracy is under our control. Check the date, and check the source.
termsPage.s4body: Sending an enquiry, and our replying to it, does not by itself create an engagement between us or any obligation on either side. An engagement begins when it is agreed separately and in writing.
termsPage.s5body: The text, design, code and marks on this site belong to YNWA unless stated otherwise. You are welcome to read, quote and link to it; please do not republish it as your own.
termsPage.s6body: We may change these terms, and the site itself, at any time. The date above tells you when this version was published.
termsPage.reviewNote: These terms are written to be accurate about what this website is and does, and deliberately do not attempt liability limits, governing-law clauses or dispute-resolution provisions. They have not been reviewed by a lawyer. Have them reviewed before launch.
